caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A two-line headline asks what people, rather than AI, need to do, with the seven-item quantity held in a wide pastel gradient tag.
visual_anatomy.layout: Seven vertically stacked central barrel-like tiers name work functions. Matching human contribution sits at the left and AI contribution at the right of each tier.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Headline and scope line → scan one tier at a time across human role, named function, and AI role → continue from strategy through integration.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large open sans headline, bold tier headings, dark sans functional labels, and short paired contribution statements set in aligned side columns.
visual_anatomy.colour: A lavender-to-aqua spectrum progresses down the central stack; the title tag uses a separate pink-to-aqua wash; most supporting text remains black on white.
visual_anatomy.surface: Off-white ground, stacked shallow cylinders with grey rims and soft shadows, lightly tinted side bands, and no dense outer grid.
visual_anatomy.modules: Seven repeating three-part rows: human responsibility, shared content function, and AI capability.
visual_anatomy.density: Medium-high: the same triad repeats seven times, allowing a reader to compare role boundaries rather than decode a new visual grammar per row.

motion.observed_state_change: The sampled intermediate state adds a full-height colour wash behind the rows, brightens the stacked tiers, and brings the paired side statements forward; the near-complete state retains the same seven human/AI mappings.
motion.motion_job: Use a shared colour sweep to draw a reader through a repeated human-versus-AI comparison while preserving the final matrix as the usable artifact.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Separate retained human judgement from tool assistance across a complete operating system.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Hold the function in a stable central column and state the complementary human and tool roles on either side, so the reader can inspect boundaries rather than a generic list of capabilities.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when the paired responsibilities are concrete enough to guide an actual handoff and the tool-side claims are current and supportable.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the seven content functions, human-versus-AI assertions, stacked-cylinder structure, title phrase, gradient treatment, side-column copy, or motion wash.

claim_boundary.note: The division of human and AI responsibilities is a source framework, not independently verified operational guidance for another domain.
